scriptLines: FechaServicio = iif(    isNull(FechaServicio),    toDate(null()),    iif(        instr(FechaServicio, '/') > 0,        toDate(FechaServicio, 'dd/MM/yyyy'),        iif(            length(FechaServicio) == 5,            addDays(toDate('1899-12-30', 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toInteger(FechaServicio)),            toDate(FechaServicio, 'yyyy-MM-dd')        )    )),

source1 derive(DemandaId = iif(     isNull(DemandaId) || trim(DemandaId) == '',     concat(         'D-',         toString(FechaServicio, 'yyyyMMdd'),         '-',         RutaHistoricaId,         '-',         ParadaHistoricaId     ),     DemandaId )) ~> derivedColumn2

derivedColumn1 derive(RutaHistoricaId = iif(    isNull(RutaHistoricaId) || trim(RutaHistoricaId) == '',    toString(null()),    iif(        startsWith(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), 'RUTA '),        iif(            length(trim(substring(trim(RutaHistoricaId), 6, 20))) == 1,            concat('RH-0', trim(substring(trim(RutaHistoricaId), 6, 20))),            concat('RH-', trim(substring(trim(RutaHistoricaId), 6, 20)))        ),        iif(            startsWith(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), 'R-'),            concat('RH-', substring(trim(RutaHistoricaId), 3, 20)),            iif(                startsWith(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), 'RH-'),                upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)),                iif(                    length(trim(RutaHistoricaId)) == 2,                    concat('RH-', trim(RutaHistoricaId)),                    upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId))                )            )        )    )),
